description:
There’s nothing like a classic. The 170 Montauk embodies the timeless look of Boston Whaler’s past, with simple lines, low-maintenance construction and pristine finish, while embracing new and modern craftsmanship like quiet-running, fuel-efficient standard 90-hp FourStroke outboard power.

Sport fishermen and pleasure cruisers alike will enjoy the 170 Montauk’s modified-V hull, which ensures quick planing and a smooth, dry ride.

It's no coincidence you see Boston Whaler hanging off the back of luxury motor yachts in many exotic ports. The 170 Montauk is “the” boat in their line-up that made whaler such an iconic brand in boating. Equally, well suited to summer picnic cruising or fishing near shore for halibut or rockfish, the 170 Montauk does it all superbly. No other 17’ boat is as seaworthy or comfortable.

Have your favorite summer playlist ready to use with the onboard Bluetooth sound system.

If you would like to reserve more than one boat at a time, please give us a call.

- Model: 170 Montauk (Center Console)
- 5 persons or 950 lbs maximum limit. 
- Rentals of 3 or more hours allow you to explore all of Santa Monica Bay.

- Maximum speed of approximately 36 mph.
- Excellent for fishing.
- Fuel included in price
